title: Large Loss Heads-Up: notification, manual start, form
walkthroughSteps: Claim Overview has a Large loss Heads-Up card: create one (any amount), continue a draft, or view the submitted one.
When incurred reaches 1M the system makes a draft and the bell says so, once. If a Heads-Up already exists, only a notice.
The form is a full page: values from the claim (editable, resettable, marked), your assessment, attachments, Save draft and Submit with a confirm.
The dashboard's "Heads-up: Monitored Claims" widget is the KCM monitoring list (Features E-F), not this form; its rows already open Claim Overview, where this card is.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC2 · Incurred reaches 1M: a draft is made and the handler is told once
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001, incurred now 1,050,000 EUR.

**You see:** Bell badge with "incurred reached 1M, a draft Heads-Up is ready". On the page, the **Large loss Heads-Up** card: Draft chip, a blue note "Incurred reached 1,050,000 EUR on 12-11-2026 ... a draft Heads-Up was made for you", **Continue Heads-Up**.

**Try:** Open the bell line: the Heads-Up form opens with the same note, and the bell line is gone (told once). Back on the claim the card keeps the note.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** detecting the threshold is the backend's job (a Finance event). The prototype shows the result: the draft the system made and the bell line. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC5 · Below 1M: create a Heads-Up by hand, no amount check
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001, incurred 125,000 EUR.

**You see:** Card: "No Heads-Up for this claim. Incurred is 125,000 EUR." and **Create Heads-Up**.

**Try:** Press it: a dialog asks why (tick one or more: May reach 1M, Public interest, High publicity, ...) with an optional note. Nothing ticked + Create shows "Tick at least one reason". Tick one, **Create draft Heads-Up**: a green toast and the form opens, filled in from the claim.

**Decision (open questions 2 and 8):** the way in is a card on Claim Overview; the handler can tick several reasons, each with a one-line hint so the boundaries are clear (DESIGN DECISION HU-1).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC3 · Pre-filled values: shown, editable, clear where they came from
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Heads-Up form of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** "From the claim" section in three groups (Loss, Policy, Financial data). Every value is in an input. Under each: "From the claim". Cause of loss says "Changed by you. Claim value: Fire" with **Use the claim value**.

**Try:** Change any value: its hint turns to "Changed by you" and the button appears. Press **Use the claim value**: it goes back.

**Decision:** the pre-fill is a snapshot from when the Heads-Up was made; later claim changes don't touch it (story rule). Labels OE / LOE / IIP / ART share / AZRe kept as the business wrote them until KCM says what to spell out.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC4 · Your assessment: Yes/No, four texts with counter, validation
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Heads-Up form of CLM-2024-001 (a fresh draft).

**You see:** "Your assessment": Cat event and Multiple LOBs affected as Yes/No (nothing ticked), then Loss, Policy structure, Rationale for loss estimation, Strategy / next steps, each with a hint and a 0/4000 counter. Attachments: "No attachments yet."

**Try:** Press **Submit Heads-Up** without filling anything: a red message at the top lists the fields to fill (Cat event, Multiple LOBs affected, Loss, Rationale, Strategy), each field shows its own error. Fill them and submit again: a confirm, then the green toast.

**Decision (open questions 1 and 4):** needed before submit: Cat, Multiple LOBs, Loss, Rationale, Strategy and the main claim facts; Policy structure is optional. 4000 characters is the limit, plain text. **Save draft** works with gaps. Same rules for every LoB until KCM says otherwise.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC4 · Attachments: list, mock upload, failed upload
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Heads-Up form of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Attachments list: "Loss adjuster report - initial.pdf" (from the claim) and "Fire brigade report.pdf" marked **Upload failed** with **Try again**. Below: **Upload files** and the claim's other documents with **Add**.

**Try:** Try again: "Uploading" with a spinner, then done. Upload a PDF: it shows Uploading, then is listed. A file over 25 MB or of another type is refused with a message. Remove with the x.

**Decision (open question 5):** PDF, Word, Excel, Outlook mail, JPG, PNG; up to 25 MB each, 10 files at most. Placeholders until the Document service sets the real limits.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC7 · Aquila components, accessibility, smaller screens, German text
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Heads-Up form of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** Only Aquila components and project tokens; every input has a label, errors are announced, the whole form works with the keyboard; the field grid goes from three columns to two and one on narrower windows.

**Try:** Make the window narrow.

Not done: German text length has not been reviewed, and there is no mobile layout beyond the narrower grid. AC8 (Product Owner and developer review, Figma link) happens outside the prototype and is left out of this ticket.
